theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_rescaled_ball_mass_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (θ : ℝ≥0∞) (R : ℝ), HasDensity n V.weight x θ → 0 < R → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ rescaledMeasure V x t (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (θ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal R ^ n))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
